parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against JAK2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary filtering on target name JAK2 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
